content:
If you missed yesterday's "Surprise and Shine" event but don't want to watch the full video that's over an hour long, Apple's YouTube channel has you covered. Check out the highlights from the event below.

Apple shares event highlight reel

In addition to the iPhone Duo and Apple's first foldable iPhone, Apple also unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max yesterday, along with the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, as well as the AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation.

The event ran for nearly 1 hour and 20 minutes and, true to Apple's style, featured members of the management team taking turns speaking to the camera, interspersed with promotional demos and product advertisement segments.

If you don't have time to watch the entire event, Apple has also released a lighthearted highlight video with a narrator using rewind and fast-forward techniques to summarize the key points of each announcement.

Apple has also uploaded the full presentation segments for each product individually, which you can watch together below.
